markdown_content: ## In theory The solution is to use "cross-fold validation." In this scheme, we separate the data into some $k$ number of "folds" and then train $k$ different models using different sub-splits: This has the great advantage of not needing to remove any more data from the training set while averaging out some of the variance in the test performance.
